response.overview: The Opal Ministry, Directed and Written by Soriba Amaih, starring Julian Gorelick & Lucas Murray. Explores Rio’s moment between life and death as his soul comes to terms with the fact that he has died. In this vibrant expression of life, The Opal Ministry touches on the topics of Identity, Mortality, and the human condition. The Opal ministry was shot over a 4 day period during a trip to Florida. The crew consisted of the Director and 2 lead actors. Shot guerilla in the Miami streets. With the sequence shots and b roll filmed in south Jersey.
response.title: The Opal Ministry
